proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON LOBBYING DISCLOSURE
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing IBM's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, including trade association and grassroots lobbying, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON SPECIAL SHAREOWNER MEETINGS
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to let holders of 10% of outstanding common stock call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL TO ADOPT A PROXY ACCESS BY-LAW
proposals.proponent: Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of New York City pension funds
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to adopt a proxy access bylaw letting shareholders holding 3% for three years nominate directors included in company proxy materials.
proposals.evidence: Your Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
